2025_117_feb_2025_pcard_report.paragraph: A line-item register of Troy School District purchasing-card (PCARD) activity for February 2025, printed 4/17/25 and carried on the April 22, 2025 Board of Education agenda. The 32-page listing shows Transaction Description, JE Description, Accounting Code, Date, Transaction Amount and Credits for each charge, with every line journalized as "FEB 2025 PCARD EXP" and posting dates running from 1/28/25 through 2/25/25. The report closes with a stated total of 267,896.50. The largest single charges are WESTIN CADILLAC DETR at 9,999.00, PIRTEK STERLING HEIGHT at 9,731.75 and HILTON HOTELS at 8,763.30.

**What it is**
Troy School District PCARD report for Feb 2025, a transaction-level listing of district purchasing-card charges submitted to the Board of Education for its April 22, 2025 meeting. Every page is headed "TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, PCARD report, Feb 2025" and footed with the page number and the print date 4/17/25, through page 32.

Five data columns per line: Transaction Description (merchant), JE Description, Accounting Code, Date, Transaction Amount and Credits. The JE Description is "FEB 2025 PCARD EXP" on every line.
